name: MADAGASCAR CHOCOBAR
ingredients: Inner Ice Cream Layer (77%): Milk & Milk Solids (Skimmed Milk Powder, Butter), Maltitol, Oligofructose, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Mass, Starch, Permitted Emulsifier (471, 433) and Stabilizer (412, 407, 461), Stevia. Outer Layer (23%): Chocolate Paste (Maltitol, Edible Vegetable Oil, Cocoa Solids, Soya Lecithin), Edible Vegetable Oil, Cocoa Butter, Wheat Crunch (2%). CONTAINS ADDED NATURE IDENTICAL VANILLA FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES
